title: Wemu: WeMuslim, Athan&Qibla
description:
Wemu features an elegant, minimalist interface. Loved by over 100 million Muslims worldwide, it helps you practice your faith anytime and anywhere.

🕌 Prayer Times
Based on your current location, this app provides accurate prayer times and plays the magnificent audio of the Athan before each prayer.

📖 Quran Kareem
Supports audio recitations from various famous reciters and translations in nearly 10 languages and helps you do the Khatam Quran.
 
💬 Discover & Chat
Chat and connect with Muslim brothers and sisters. Share reflections on Quran recitation, send and receive blessings, and post your questions to get answers.

🧭 Qibla
This feature provides an easy-to-use compass that points in the direction of the Kaaba.

📅 Hijri
This feature allows you to look up the Islamic calendar for future prayer times and also provides a function to record your daily prayers.

🤲 Azkar
This feature includes Dua and remembrance based on Hadiths and the Quran, which can be easily read and recited.

📿 Tasbih
This feature includes an electronic tasbih and prayer beads counter to assist you in keeping count while reading your prayer or Dua.

🕋 Hajj&Umrah
This feature provides the guide for the journey of Hajj, including the explanations and instructions for the ritual.

*Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details.
*Foreground service permission are required
The use-case of FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC permission: Continue to download the audio of the Quran in the background.
The use-case of FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK permission: Continue to play the Quran in the background.
The use-case of FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE permission: Continue to display the prayer time reminder in the notification bar in the background.

---------------------------------------------------------

If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at:
support@wemuapp.com

Learn more about Wemu at:
https://www.wemuapp.com
